protocol_clarification: The historical139 J2 oracle uses independent_figure_vector.acceleration, a body-axis vector formula. The term tensor J2 reference in protocol187 inaccurately described its implementation. Independent tensor-potential checks belong to184. The additive degree-two force model and declared gates are unchanged; the original pre-result protocol bytes are retained.
limitations: 125 epochs, not a continuous or arbitrary-IC guarantee.
1800-to-900-second refinement is empirical reference sensitivity, not a rigorous bound.
Annual source integrals are absent; no annual corrected E/P/J budget qualification.
JPL residual is not observational uncertainty or full-model accuracy.
Research IAS15 only; optional library and raw JPL cache are not portable runtime dependencies.
Timing sample is three alternating runs, with considerable variation; no universal speed/FPS claim.
